answer: Hit the economy with brief, unannounced price shocks in single niches and watch who moves together. Offer one identity a sudden premium for a pearl, another a crash in basalt, a third a drought premium in the meadow, each shock hitting only one specialty at a time. Genuine strangers react unevenly, with different costs and appetites, while one operator behind many masks moves them in the same rhythm and size, because one mind sets every response. Repeated shocks turn that hidden coordination into a fingerprint no single answer can fake.
